title: Chameleon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Chameleon dancing: body, curled tail, legs, head, eye, tongue, and music notes -->
  <!-- Tail spiral (bright green) -->
  <path d='M30,72 C22,74 16,70 16,63 C16,56 23,53 28,57 C32,60 31,66 26,67' fill='none' stroke='#6cd93a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body (bright green) -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#4ec928'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#7ae24f'/>
  <!-- Body ridges (lighter green) -->
  <path d='M38,64 L44,61 M46,65 L52,61 M54,65 L60,61 M62,65 L67,62' stroke='#a8f07f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Back leg dancing (green) -->
  <path d='M62,78 L68,86 L74,84' fill='none' stroke='#3aa81e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Back foot (lighter green) -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='84' r='3.5' fill='#8ee065'/>
  <!-- Front leg dancing up (green) -->
  <path d='M44,76 L42,88 L48,92' fill='none' stroke='#3aa81e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Front foot (lighter green) -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='92' r='3.5' fill='#8ee065'/>
  <!-- Head (bright green) -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='58' r='12' fill='#4ec928'/>
  <!-- Snout / mouth area (lighter green) -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7ae24f'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile (dark green line) -->
  <path d='M82,64 Q86,67 89,63' fill='none' stroke='#2a7a12' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eye socket (bright yellow) -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='54' r='6' fill='#ffd83a'/>
  <!-- Eye (dark green pupil) -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#1e5a0c'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='53' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Casque/crest on head (orange) -->
  <path d='M68,50 Q72,40 80,48' fill='#ff9d2e' stroke='#e07b10' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Tongue out (pink) -->
  <path d='M89,64 Q94,66 93,70' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fa8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='71' r='2.5' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <!-- Back crest bobbing (orange) -->
  <path d='M44,56 L48,50 L52,56 M54,55 L58,49 L62,55' fill='none' stroke='#ff9d2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Music notes (bright blue and yellow) -->
  <g fill='#ffd83a'>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='34' rx='3' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 20 34)'/>
    <rect x='22' y='22' width='1.8' height='12' rx='0.8'/>
    <path d='M22,22 Q27,23 26,27' fill='none' stroke='#ffd83a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#6fd4ff'>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='26' rx='2.6' ry='2.2' transform='rotate(-20 34 26)'/>
    <rect x='35.6' y='16' width='1.6' height='10' rx='0.7'/>
    <path d='M35.6,16 Q40,17 39,20.5' fill='none' stroke='#6fd4ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd83a'>
    <ellipse cx='90' cy='40' rx='2.6' ry='2.2' transform='rotate(-20 90 40)'/>
    <rect x='91.6' y='30' width='1.6' height='10' rx='0.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
